settings.doc: Experimental. 1 keeps a render pass open through the game's Barrier calls that ask only for fragment ordering and texture invalidation, when no draw of the pass can write a storage buffer or image; the next draw that samples a written target gets a by-region barrier in the pass (the feedback layout). In scenes with about a thousand such barriers a frame this cuts the passes from about 1200 to 130 and the GPU time from 24.5 to 7.8 ms. The game's barrier orders every pixel, the in-pass by-region barrier only the pixel a draw writes: a driver that runs it per screen tile can show flicker or squares at the edges of water, decals or particles.
1 gives 3D block-compressed images block views too. On some AMD cards a GPU write past the end of the image's memory loses the Vulkan device, and the game stops.

desc.pt-BR: Define os quatro valores abaixo. Vívido: mais contraste e saturação, sombras um pouco mais abertas (feito para telas OLED). Clareza: um pouco mais de contraste, saturação e brilho. Mexer em um valor torna o perfil Personalizado. O HUD muda com a imagem; este menu não.
desc.zh-Hans: 同时设置下面四项。鲜艳：对比度和饱和度更高，暗部略微提亮（为 OLED 屏幕调校）。清晰：对比度、饱和度和亮度都略高。改动任一项后，配置变为自定义。HUD 随画面一起变化，本菜单不随之变化。

settings.doc: Colour adjustment of the picture, HUD included, before it is scaled to the window: brightness (-30 to 30, added in %), contrast and saturation (70 to 150 and 50 to 200 %), gamma (0.8 to 1.2, below 1 brightens dark tones). At 0, 100, 100 and 1 nothing runs. color_preset is the menu's profile (default, vivid, clarity, custom), which sets the four. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.

desc.en: Colour strength against grey; 100 % leaves it.
desc.ru: Сила цвета относительно серого; 100 % — без изменений.
desc.pt-BR: Força da cor em relação ao cinza; 100 % não muda nada.
desc.zh-Hans: 颜色相对灰色的强度；100% 表示不调整。

settings.doc: Colour adjustment of the picture, HUD included, before it is scaled to the window: brightness (-30 to 30, added in %), contrast and saturation (70 to 150 and 50 to 200 %), gamma (0.8 to 1.2, below 1 brightens dark tones). At 0, 100, 100 and 1 nothing runs. color_preset is the menu's profile (default, vivid, clarity, custom), which sets the four. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.
1 draws the contact-shadow factor in grey in place of the picture. The frame shows a grey debug image while it is set; has no effect when contact shadows are off.

desc.en: Small sun shadows the shadow maps miss: at feet, under stones, in grass and creases. Traced on the screen after lighting. Takes effect at the next start.
desc.ru: Мелкие тени от солнца, которых нет на картах теней: у ног, под камнями, в траве и складках. Считаются по экрану после освещения. Действует после перезапуска.
desc.pt-BR: Pequenas sombras do sol que os mapas de sombra não pegam: nos pés, sob pedras, na grama e em dobras. Traçadas na tela depois da iluminação. Vale no próximo início.
desc.zh-Hans: 阴影贴图遗漏的细小太阳阴影：脚下、石头下、草丛和褶皱中。在光照之后于屏幕空间追踪。下次启动时生效。

settings.doc: Screen-space contact shadows, strength in percent (0 = off): after the game lights its scene, each pixel traces a short way toward the sun through the depth buffer and darkens where something close blocks it, adding the small shadows at feet, under stones and in grass that the shadow maps miss. Read at start.

1 records why ready guest threads wait for a virtual core and for how long, with a histogram every 60 presents. Turns on host-call and SVC depth tracking and writes many log lines (one per present over 25 ms); frames get slower.

<first>-<last> frame range (with TOTK_TRACE=sched) that records every state change and wake of the guest threads, then writes a file at the last frame. Recording adds overhead to every thread switch in the range and writes one file; tools/crit_path.py reads it.
Path of the file that crit writes. Only moves the file; nothing is written without crit.

desc.en: Optimisation: updates descriptors in bulk.
desc.ru: Оптимизация: обновляет дескрипторы пачками.
desc.pt-BR: Otimização: atualiza os descritores em lote.
desc.zh-Hans: 优化：批量更新描述符。

settings.doc: Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk, skip push constants that did not change, bind only the vertex buffers a draw reads, compare and copy each draw's state inline, and rebuild only the parts of a draw's bindings, shaders and pipeline whose inputs changed since the draw before (check: build everything and log any difference from what would have been kept).

Where block-linear textures are deswizzled: auto or gpu uses a compute pass where the texture's storage is an imported pool and the CPU elsewhere, cpu always uses the CPU, check uses the GPU and also deswizzles every upload on the CPU and compares the two. cpu brings back the long frames on entering new areas (the replay thread deswizzles every texture); check waits for the GPU at every upload and is for testing only. The log names the mode in use.

Device profile: auto (the Steam Deck when this is one), desktop or deck. On a Steam Deck the keys this file does not set default to fullscreen = 1, window_size = 1280x800, output_res = 1280x800, render_scale = game, vk_present = fifo and fps_limit = 40 (starting points, not measured yet). Read at start.

desc.en: While a dialogue box is open, left click presses B (it continues the text and skips its scroll) and right click presses A, instead of the buttons they are bound to (Y by default, which opens the dialogue log, and ZL). Dialogue choices keep the pointer: left click picks (game 1.4.3).
desc.ru: Пока открыто окно диалога, левый щелчок нажимает B (продолжает текст и пропускает его прокрутку), а правый — A, вместо назначенных им кнопок (по умолчанию Y, она открывает журнал диалога, и ZL). В вариантах ответа по-прежнему работает указатель: левый щелчок выбирает (версия игры 1.4.3).
desc.pt-BR: Enquanto uma caixa de diálogo está aberta, o clique esquerdo aperta B (continua o texto e pula a rolagem) e o direito aperta A, em vez dos botões aos quais estão atribuídos (Y por padrão, que abre o registro do diálogo, e ZL). As escolhas de diálogo continuam com o ponteiro: o clique esquerdo escolhe (jogo 1.4.3).
desc.zh-Hans: 对话框打开时，鼠标左键按下 B 键（继续对话并跳过文字滚动），右键按下 A 键，而不是它们所绑定的按键（默认为 Y，会打开对话记录；以及 ZL）。对话选项仍使用指针：左键选择（游戏 1.4.3）。

settings.doc: The mouse buttons in dialogue, 1.4.3 only. 1: while a dialogue box is open left click presses B (it continues the text and skips its scroll) and right click presses A, instead of their bindings (Y by default, which opens the dialogue log, and ZL). Dialogue choices keep the pointer, where left click picks. Works with menu_cursor = 0 too. The clicks stay B and A for half a second after a box closes, as the game closes the box between two lines of a conversation. 0 (the default) leaves both buttons on their bindings there, one key per controller button. Changes while the game runs.

The application whose name and artwork the status shows. The default is the project's own application, registered as "TotK Recomp" with the port's green ring icon as its art. Register your own at discord.com/developers (name and art are yours to choose) and put its id here.
The key of the application's uploaded art asset shown as the status's large image.

desc.en: Shows "Playing TotK Recomp" with the play time in your Discord status while the game runs. discord_app_id and discord_image in totk.ini choose the application.
desc.ru: Пока игра запущена, показывает «Играю в TotK Recomp» со временем игры в статусе Discord. Приложение выбирают discord_app_id и discord_image в totk.ini.
desc.pt-BR: Mostra "Jogando TotK Recomp" com o tempo de jogo no seu status do Discord enquanto o jogo roda. discord_app_id e discord_image no totk.ini escolhem a aplicação.
desc.zh-Hans: 游戏运行时在 Discord 状态中显示“正在玩 TotK Recomp”及游戏时长。totk.ini 中的 discord_app_id 和 discord_image 选择应用。

settings.doc: Rich Presence: "Playing TotK Recomp" with the play time in your Discord status while the game runs, through the local IPC of a running Discord client. 1 = on; the Menu tab of the settings menu (F1) switches it too, and the change reaches the presence thread at once.

desc.en: NVIDIA DLSS for the 3D scene (NVIDIA RTX GPUs; nvngx_dlss.dll next to totk.exe): smoother edges and less shimmer. The HUD is not touched. The mode below sets the resolution it works from. Takes effect after a restart.
desc.ru: NVIDIA DLSS для 3D-сцены (видеокарты NVIDIA RTX; nvngx_dlss.dll рядом с totk.exe): ровнее края и меньше мерцания. Интерфейс не затрагивается. Режим ниже задаёт разрешение, с которым он работает. Действует после перезапуска.
desc.pt-BR: NVIDIA DLSS para a cena 3D (placas NVIDIA RTX; nvngx_dlss.dll ao lado do totk.exe): bordas mais suaves e menos cintilação. O HUD não é afetado. O modo abaixo define a resolução de onde ele parte. Vale após reiniciar.
desc.zh-Hans: 用于 3D 场景的 NVIDIA DLSS（NVIDIA RTX 显卡；nvngx_dlss.dll 放在 totk.exe 旁）：边缘更平滑，闪烁更少。HUD 不受影响。下方的模式决定它的工作分辨率。重启后生效。

settings.doc: NVIDIA DLSS / DLAA for the 3D scene, on NVIDIA RTX GPUs with the DLSS model from NVIDIA's DLSS SDK next to the executable (Windows: nvngx_dlss.dll next to totk.exe; Linux: libnvidia-ngx-dlss.so.<version> next to totk, with the NVIDIA driver's libnvidia-ngx.so.1 installed); elsewhere the setting does nothing. The HUD is drawn after it and is not touched. Read at start.

label.pt-BR: Névoa e partículas após o DLAA
label.zh-Hans: DLAA 之后绘制雾和粒子

desc.en: With DLAA, fog, dust and other particles are drawn over the picture DLSS has already smoothed, as the game draws them without DLSS: small particles in fog (shrines) no longer vanish or leave trails. Off: DLSS also processes these effects, as before. DLAA mode only; the upscaling DLSS modes always process them. Applies at once.
desc.ru: С DLAA туман, пыль и другие частицы рисуются поверх картинки, уже сглаженной DLSS, как игра рисует их без DLSS: мелкие частицы в тумане (святилища) больше не пропадают и не оставляют шлейфов. Выкл.: DLSS обрабатывает и эти эффекты, как раньше. Только в режиме DLAA; режимы DLSS с повышением разрешения обрабатывают их всегда. Применяется сразу.
desc.pt-BR: Com DLAA, a névoa, a poeira e outras partículas são desenhadas sobre a imagem já suavizada pelo DLSS, como o jogo as desenha sem DLSS: partículas pequenas na névoa (santuários) não somem mais nem deixam rastros. Desligado: o DLSS também processa esses efeitos, como antes. Só no modo DLAA; os modos de DLSS que aumentam a resolução sempre os processam. Aplica-se na hora.
desc.zh-Hans: 开启 DLAA 时，雾、灰尘和其他粒子绘制在 DLSS 已平滑的画面之上，与游戏不用 DLSS 时的绘制方式相同：雾中的细小粒子（神庙中）不再消失，也不再留下拖影。关闭：DLSS 也处理这些效果，与以前相同。仅用于 DLAA 模式；提升分辨率的 DLSS 模式始终处理它们。立即生效。

settings.doc: With DLAA (dlaa = 1, dlss = dlaa), fog, dust and other particles are drawn over the picture DLSS has already smoothed, as the game draws them without DLSS, so small particles in fog (shrines) no longer vanish or leave trails. 0: DLSS processes these effects too, as before (the default until the inventory preview, the scope and water edges are checked on NVIDIA). The upscaling DLSS modes always process them. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.
0 turns off the camera jitter fed to DLSS. DLSS gets no jitter between frames; a test setting.
0 sends zero motion vectors to DLSS. DLSS sees no motion, so moving content can smear; a test setting.
1 shows the reactive mask in place of the picture. The frame shows a debug image while it is set.
1 shows the motion vectors in place of the picture, x in red and y in green. The frame shows a debug image while it is set.

Per-object motion vectors for DLSS: characters, animals and moving objects get their own motion instead of the camera's, so DLSS keeps their history instead of smearing or rejecting it. Costs some CPU time each frame (about 1-2 ms on a laptop CPU); 0 leaves camera-only motion. Read at start.
1 logs what is drawn into the light target that DLSS reads. Adds log output and per-draw work.
1 times the DLSS passes on the GPU. Adds GPU timestamps and log lines.

desc.en: DLAA draws the 3D scene at full resolution. Quality, Balanced, Performance and Ultra Performance draw it at 67, 58, 50 and 33 % and let DLSS scale it up, which saves GPU time; they replace the 3D render scale. Takes effect at once.
desc.ru: DLAA рисует 3D-сцену в полном разрешении. «Качество», «Баланс», «Производительность» и «Макс. производительность» рисуют её в 67, 58, 50 и 33 % и масштабируют через DLSS, что экономит время видеокарты; они заменяют масштаб 3D-отрисовки. Действует сразу.
desc.pt-BR: DLAA desenha a cena 3D na resolução cheia. Qualidade, Equilibrado, Desempenho e Ultra Desempenho a desenham em 67, 58, 50 e 33 % e deixam o DLSS ampliá-la, o que poupa tempo da GPU; eles substituem a escala 3D. Vale na hora.
desc.zh-Hans: DLAA 以全分辨率绘制 3D 场景。质量、平衡、性能和超级性能分别以 67%、58%、50% 和 33% 绘制，再由 DLSS 放大，以节省 GPU 时间；它们会取代 3D 渲染比例。立即生效。

settings.doc: What DLSS works from: dlaa (the 3D scene at full size), quality, balanced, performance or ultra_performance (the scene at 67, 58, 50 or 33 % of the output, scaled up by DLSS; these replace render_scale and sharpen texture filtering to match). They apply only with dlaa = 1 and the DLSS model next to the executable; otherwise the scene follows render_scale. Changes while the game runs take effect at once (1.4.3; 1.2.1 at the next start).

desc.en: Reduces the faint trails behind moving characters, animals and what they hold: DLSS takes less of the previous frames there. Stronger removes more of the trails and leaves those edges a little less smooth. Applies at once.
desc.ru: Убирает слабые шлейфы за движущимися персонажами, животными и тем, что они держат: DLSS берёт там меньше от прошлых кадров. Чем сильнее, тем меньше шлейфов и тем чуть менее гладкие края. Действует сразу.
desc.pt-BR: Reduz os rastros fracos atrás de personagens, animais e do que eles seguram em movimento: ali o DLSS usa menos dos quadros anteriores. Mais forte remove mais rastros e deixa essas bordas um pouco menos suaves. Vale na hora.
desc.zh-Hans: 减少移动中的角色、动物及其手持物品身后的淡淡拖影：DLSS 在这些位置少用之前的帧。越强拖影越少，这些边缘也略欠平滑。立即生效。

settings.doc: frame before, DLSS is told to favour the current frame by this percentage (0, 35, 65 or 100; 0 off). Higher removes more of the trails and leaves those edges a little less smooth. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.

desc.en: Which DLSS model runs. Automatic follows NVIDIA's advice per mode: K for DLAA, Quality and Balanced, M for Performance, L for Ultra Performance. J: slightly less ghosting behind moving characters, a little more flicker. K: the sharpest model in every mode. Applies at once.
desc.ru: Какая модель DLSS работает. «Автоматически» следует совету NVIDIA для каждого режима: K для DLAA, «Качества» и «Баланса», M для «Производительности», L для «Макс. производительности». J: чуть меньше шлейфов за движущимися персонажами, немного больше мерцания. K: самая чёткая модель во всех режимах. Действует сразу.
desc.pt-BR: Qual modelo do DLSS roda. Automático segue a recomendação da NVIDIA para cada modo: K para DLAA, Qualidade e Equilibrado, M para Desempenho, L para Ultra Desempenho. J: um pouco menos de rastro atrás de personagens em movimento, um pouco mais de cintilação. K: o modelo mais nítido em todos os modos. Vale na hora.
desc.zh-Hans: 运行哪个 DLSS 模型。自动按 NVIDIA 对各模式的建议：DLAA、质量和平衡用 K，性能用 M，超级性能用 L。J：移动角色身后的拖影略少，闪烁略多。K：所有模式都用最清晰的模型。立即生效。

settings.doc: The DLSS model: default (NVIDIA's advice per mode: K for dlaa, quality and balanced, M for performance, L for ultra_performance), k (K in every mode) or j (the other transformer model: slightly less ghosting behind moving characters, a little more flicker). Any other model by its letter, a to m: on slower RTX cards the older model e is cheaper. Changes while the game runs take effect at once (DLSS starts a new history).
1 builds a reactive mask for DLSS where it ran. Changes how DLSS blends moving areas; a test setting.

Frame number to dump: every render pass target and storage image of that frame is copied out as PNG, with passes.txt and images.txt. Writes many PNG files and shader hashes to disk and slows the dumped frame; size is capped by the dump code.
<addr>:<size>[:<off>:<stride>:<w>:<h>] snapshots one GPU buffer range after every logged pass of a dump. Writes buf_<pass>.bin files and bufs.txt; has no effect without dump.
Folder that receives the frame dump files. Only moves the output.
Frame number; logs the frames from there up to the dumped frame into passes.txt, with PNGs only of targets up to 64K texels. Writes a longer passes.txt and more PNGs; has no effect without dump.

desc.en: Lets the game lower the 3D scene to 90 or 80 %. It judges by an estimate made for the Switch that ignores your GPU, so wide scenes drop even on a fast PC. Off keeps the render scale.
desc.ru: Игра снижает 3D-сцену до 90 или 80 %. Она судит по оценке для Switch, не учитывающей вашу видеокарту, поэтому широкие сцены снижаются даже на быстром ПК. Выключено: остаётся масштаб отрисовки.
desc.pt-BR: Deixa o jogo reduzir a cena 3D para 90 ou 80 %. Ele decide por uma estimativa feita para o Switch que ignora sua GPU, então cenas largas caem mesmo num PC rápido. Desligada, mantém a escala da renderização.
desc.zh-Hans: 让游戏把 3D 场景降到 90 % 或 80 %。它依据为 Switch 制定的估算，不考虑你的显卡，因此即使在高性能 PC 上宽场景也会降低。关闭时保持渲染比例。

settings.doc: Dynamic resolution: 1 lets the game lower the scene to 90 or 80 % of that size, 0 keeps it at 100 %. The game decides by a cost estimate made for the Switch, which grows with the scene's width and ignores how fast your GPU is: a scene wider than about 3000 pixels can drop to 80 % on any GPU. 1 is the default. 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3. Changes in the menu take effect at once.

Records only the pipeline dynamic states (cull mode, depth and stencil tests, vertex input, blend enables, equations and write masks, ...) whose values changed since the last draw in the command buffer, also across pipeline changes; 0 records the full set at every change of pipeline state, as before; ab alternates with the ab blocks. Fewer commands per pipeline change on the render and recorder threads; a driver that loses dynamic state across pipeline binds would draw with stale state. TOTK_TRACE=perf prints the calls and commands per submission.

Folder of the game's ExeFS (with main.npdm); a relative path is relative to totk.exe's folder. Without it, an exefs folder next to totk.exe is used, else the path set at build time. The game code is compiled into totk.exe, and the loader checks the files here by SHA-256, so files from another build or game version stop the start with a message.

0 samples a target that an earlier draw of the same pass wrote with no barrier; restart ends and restarts the pass behind a full barrier; otherwise the feedback-loop layout is used when the GPU supports it. 0 brings back the old behaviour that the barrier fixed, so the picture can break in passes that read a target they draw into; restart costs extra passes.
Patch set that holds the game's dynamic resolution at 100 percent (the scene tier). The resolution code switches this set from dynamic_res (on at 0); a manual value is replaced.

desc.en: Fills the driver-reserved constant bank c0 (storage sizes, dispatch size, point size, base instance) instead of reading zeros.
desc.ru: Заполняет зарезервированный драйвером банк констант c0 (размеры хранилищ, размер запуска, размер точки, базовый экземпляр) вместо чтения нулей.
desc.pt-BR: Preenche o banco de constantes c0 reservado ao driver (tamanhos de armazenamento, tamanho do dispatch, tamanho do ponto, instância base) em vez de ler zeros.
desc.zh-Hans: 填充驱动保留的常量组 c0（存储缓冲区大小、派发大小、点大小、基础实例），而不是读取零值。

settings.doc: Fill the driver-reserved constant bank c0 (storage sizes, dispatch size, point size, base instance) instead of zeros.

label.zh-Hans: 清零新的 GPU 内存

desc.en: New GPU memory pools start zero-filled, as Switch memory does.
desc.ru: Новые пулы памяти GPU заполняются нулями, как память Switch.
desc.pt-BR: Novos pools de memória da GPU começam zerados, como a memória do Switch.
desc.zh-Hans: 新的 GPU 内存池初始内容为零，与 Switch 内存一致。

settings.doc: New GPU memory pools start zero-filled, as Switch memory does.

label.ru: Запись последних кадров (для отчёта о фризе)

desc.en: Keeps a short history and saves it when a frame freezes.
desc.ru: Хранит короткую историю и сохраняет её, когда кадр подвисает.
desc.pt-BR: Guarda um histórico curto e o salva quando um quadro trava.
desc.zh-Hans: 保留一小段历史记录，在画面卡住时保存。

settings.doc: Flight recorder: keeps the last frames and saves them to a flight folder next to the folder of totk.exe when a frame takes longer than flight_spike_ms (0 to 60000).
Comma-separated frame numbers that trigger a flight-recorder dump. Writes a dump folder when each frame is reached; has no effect unless the flight recorder (TOTK_FLIGHT=1) is on.
Folder for flight-recorder dumps; the default is flight beside the folder of totk.exe. Only moves the output.
Number of presents the flight recorder keeps. A larger ring keeps more history and more thumbnails in memory; has no effect unless TOTK_FLIGHT=1.

desc.en: Frame time that counts as a freeze.
desc.ru: Время кадра, которое считается подвисанием.
desc.pt-BR: Tempo de quadro que conta como travamento.
desc.zh-Hans: 算作卡顿的帧时间。

settings.doc: Flight recorder: keeps the last frames and saves them to a flight folder next to the folder of totk.exe when a frame takes longer than flight_spike_ms (0 to 60000).
0 turns off the 320x180 thumbnail the flight recorder saves for each present. Dumps hold only frames.tsv; thumbnails cost a GPU blit per present when on.

1 copies one span from the lowest to the highest flushed address of a pool, as an older version did. Copies far more data to the GPU in crowded towns: an estimated 30-50 ms of GPU time per large copy over PCIe 3.0 x8.

desc.en: How much of the world the camera shows, in percent of the game's own. Game versions 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3.
desc.ru: Сколько мира показывает камера, в процентах от игрового. Для версий игры 1.1.0, 1.2.1 и 1.4.3.
desc.pt-BR: Quanto do mundo a câmera mostra, em porcentagem do original do jogo. Nas versões 1.1.0, 1.2.1 e 1.4.3 do jogo.
desc.zh-Hans: 镜头能看到多大范围，以游戏自身视野的百分比表示。支持游戏版本 1.1.0、1.2.1 和 1.4.3。

settings.doc: Field of view, in percent of the game's own: 70 to 140, 100 (the default) leaves the camera as it is. Higher shows more of the world around Link. Game versions 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.

Patch set that scales the camera's vertical view angle by the field-of-view setting. The resolution code switches this set itself whenever the field of view is not 100 percent; a manual value is replaced.
Older key, read only while fps_limit is unset: fps60 = 0 means a limit of 30.

desc.en: The most frames per second the game draws. Above 60 is experimental and needs Game speed follows the clock.
desc.ru: Наибольшее число кадров в секунду. Выше 60 — экспериментальный режим, нужна «Скорость игры по часам».
desc.pt-BR: O máximo de quadros por segundo que o jogo desenha. Acima de 60 é experimental e precisa de Velocidade do jogo pelo relógio.
desc.zh-Hans: 游戏每秒绘制的最高帧数。高于 60 帧为实验性功能，需要开启“游戏速度跟随时钟”。

settings.doc: Frame rate limit: 30, 40, 45, 60, 90, 120, 144, any whole rate from 30 to 240, or display (the refresh rate of the window's monitor, at most 240). A higher rate gives 240: above it the game's physics runs out of memory. Above 60 is experimental and needs realtime = 1. Changes while the game runs take effect at once. With mailbox or fifo presentation (vk_present, the default) a frame reaches the screen at a vertical blank, so a limit that does not divide the monitor's refresh rate keeps each frame on screen for a different number of refreshes. On a 320 Hz monitor 80, 64, 40 and 32 divide it and 90 does not: 90 fps alternates 3 and 4 refreshes per frame, which reads as judder while the frame counter still shows 90. Likewise on 240 Hz 60, 48 and 40 divide it and on 144 Hz 72, 48 and 36 do, while 60 does not. vk_present = immediate shows a frame as soon as it is presented, without this quantisation, at the cost of tearing. A monitor running with variable refresh (FreeSync, G-Sync) follows the frames instead, so there any limit inside its range is even.
