desc.pt-BR: Evita que objetos pisquem no lugar errado ou que o plano distante fique achatado por um quadro, esperando o jogo terminar de reescrever os dados de nível de detalhe antes que a GPU os leia.
desc.zh-Hans: 等待游戏改写完细节层次数据后再让 GPU 读取，避免物体错位闪现，或远景有一帧变平。

settings.doc: Render fixes. Wait for the game to finish rewriting level-of-detail data before the GPU reads it: stops objects flashing in the wrong place and a flat far field for a frame.

desc.en: Skips the game's setup for lowering model and texture detail when the frame rate drops, as the emulator mod Disable LOD Quality Reduction does. Game versions 1.2.1 and 1.4.3. Leave it off on weak PCs: there this drop keeps the frame rate up.
desc.ru: Пропускает настройку игры, снижающую детализацию моделей и текстур при падении частоты кадров, как эмуляторный мод Disable LOD Quality Reduction. Только для версий игры 1.2.1 и 1.4.3. На слабых ПК не включайте: там это снижение и держит частоту кадров.
desc.pt-BR: Pula a configuração do jogo que reduz o detalhe de modelos e texturas quando a taxa de quadros cai, como faz o mod de emulador Disable LOD Quality Reduction. Só nas versões 1.2.1 e 1.4.3 do jogo. Deixe desligado em PCs fracos: lá essa redução mantém a taxa de quadros.
desc.zh-Hans: 跳过游戏在帧率下降时降低模型和纹理细节的设置，与模拟器模组 Disable LOD Quality Reduction 的作用相同。仅适用于游戏版本 1.2.1 和 1.4.3。低配电脑请勿开启：在那里正是这种降低维持了帧率。

settings.doc: Steady detail under load: 1 skips the game's setup for lowering model and texture detail when the frame rate drops, as the emulator mod "Disable LOD Quality Reduction" does (set steady); 0 (the default) leaves it. Leave it off on weak PCs, where that drop keeps the frame rate up. Game versions 1.2.1 and 1.4.3. Read at start.

desc.en: How far a gamepad stick moves before the game sees it. Raise it if the character or the camera moves on its own: let go of the stick, read "stick now" and set the dead zone a few percent above it.
desc.ru: Насколько нужно отклонить стик геймпада, чтобы игра это заметила. Увеличьте, если персонаж или камера двигаются сами: отпустите стик, посмотрите «стик сейчас» и поставьте мёртвую зону на несколько процентов выше.
desc.pt-BR: Quanto um analógico do controle precisa se mover antes que o jogo perceba. Aumente se o personagem ou a câmera se moverem sozinhos: solte o analógico, leia "analógico agora" e coloque a zona morta alguns por cento acima.
desc.zh-Hans: 手柄摇杆要推动多远游戏才会响应。如果角色或视角会自己移动，请调高此值：松开摇杆，查看“当前摇杆”，把死区设得比它高几个百分点。

settings.doc: The dead zone of one stick, in place of stick_deadzone for that stick (0 to 50; unset = stick_deadzone). The Controls tab shows each stick's deflection now, so a drifting stick's resting value can be read off.

desc.en: On the Purah Pad's map, the left mouse button presses A at the map's cursor instead of the button it is bound to (Y by default). Needs Mouse in the game's menus (game 1.4.3).
desc.ru: На карте игры левая кнопка мыши нажимает A у курсора карты, а не назначенную ей кнопку (по умолчанию Y). Нужна «Мышь в меню игры» (версия игры 1.4.3).
desc.pt-BR: No mapa do jogo, o botão esquerdo do mouse aperta A no cursor do mapa, em vez do botão ao qual está atribuído (Y por padrão). Requer Mouse nos menus do jogo (jogo 1.4.3).
desc.zh-Hans: 在游戏地图上，鼠标左键在地图光标处按下 A 键，而不是按下它所绑定的按键（默认为 Y）。需要开启“在游戏菜单中使用鼠标”（游戏 1.4.3）。

settings.doc: The left mouse button on the Purah Pad's map, 1.4.3 only. 1: it presses A at the map's cursor instead of the button it is bound to (Y by default). Needs menu_cursor = 1, which finds the map. 0 (the default) leaves the left button on its binding there, one key per controller button. Changes while the game runs.

desc.en: How game memory is shared with the GPU.
desc.ru: Как память игры передаётся видеокарте.
desc.pt-BR: Como a memória do jogo é compartilhada com a GPU.
desc.zh-Hans: 游戏内存如何与 GPU 共享。

settings.doc: Game memory shared with the GPU: auto (mirror on a discrete GPU, import on an integrated one), import (host memory imported into Vulkan), mirror (pools used as buffers get a copy in video memory) or verify (mirror plus a check of every copy; slow). On a discrete GPU import can be far slower than mirror, not slightly slower: the GPU reads the game's pools over PCIe. A 5070 Ti Laptop went from 6 ms to 135-230 ms of GPU time per frame with import (5 fps on the title screen, bound: gpu, every line of the perf window waiting on a fence). The log names the mode in use: "mem: mode import" or "mem: mode mirror".

Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk, skip push constants that did not change, bind only the vertex buffers a draw reads, compare and copy each draw's state inline, and rebuild only the parts of a draw's bindings, shaders and pipeline whose inputs changed since the draw before (check: build everything and log any difference from what would have been kept).

desc.en: Language of this menu and the overlay.
desc.ru: Язык этого меню и индикатора.
desc.pt-BR: Idioma deste menu e do indicador.
desc.zh-Hans: 本菜单和性能浮层的语言。

settings.doc: Language of the settings menu and the overlay: en, ru, pt-BR or zh-Hans. Default: the Windows display language, English if it is none of them.

<frame>[:<frames per page>] opens the menu at that frame, shows each tab for 30 frames (or the given count), saves one screenshot per tab and closes the menu. The menu opens by itself and screenshots are written.

On Linux, 1 asks fontconfig which font file draws each menu language's name, and 0 keeps the fixed distribution paths (/usr/share/fonts/noto-cjk/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc and four more). The menu merges that file into its font atlas. 0 is for a system whose fontconfig resolves to a font the menu's parser cannot read; the log then says menu: system font ... left out. Has no effect on Windows, where the file names are fixed, and none on a language the ASCII font already draws. The atlas is rebuilt when the window size or the menu language changes. TOTK_MENU_FONT names a file directly and wins over both.

MiB of system memory kept free for Windows, other programs and the game's own heap when the renderer sizes what it keeps in device memory, where device memory takes system memory (integrated GPUs, and discrete GPUs whose driver charges it to the process). A larger value keeps fewer released textures and spare blocks when the system runs short; a smaller one lets the game use more before it holds back.

label.zh-Hans: 在游戏菜单中使用鼠标

desc.en: In the game's own menus (title, inventory, shops, dialogue choices) the pointer shows: the item under it is selected, left click confirms, right click goes back. Only after the mouse or a key was used last, so a gamepad sees the menus unchanged (game 1.4.3).
desc.ru: В меню самой игры (заставка, инвентарь, магазины, варианты ответа) появляется указатель: пункт под ним выбирается, левый щелчок подтверждает, правый возвращает назад. Только если последними использовались мышь или клавиатура, поэтому с геймпадом меню не меняются (версия игры 1.4.3).
desc.pt-BR: Nos menus do próprio jogo (título, inventário, lojas, escolhas de diálogo) o ponteiro aparece: o item sob ele fica selecionado, o clique esquerdo confirma e o direito volta. Só depois de usar o mouse ou uma tecla por último, então com um controle os menus ficam como antes (jogo 1.4.3).
desc.zh-Hans: 在游戏自身的菜单中（标题、背包、商店、对话选项）显示指针：指针下的项目被选中，左键确认，右键返回。仅在最后使用的是鼠标或键盘时生效，因此使用手柄时菜单保持不变（游戏 1.4.3）。

settings.doc: The mouse in the game's menus, 1.4.3 only (title, inventory, System tab, Options, shops, dialogue choices): while a menu has the game's focus box the pointer shows, the item under it takes the focus, a left click is A on it and a right click is B. On the map the mouse moves the map's cursor and the scroll wheel zooms. 0 leaves the menus and the map to the keys and the pad. Changes while the game runs.
1 logs what the menu cursor code reads at every screen change. Only adds log lines.
Folder for the menu_test screenshots; the default is the working directory. Only moves the output.

<frame>:<key>=<value>[,...][;...] changes settings live at that frame, with or without the menu open; SAVE=1 also writes totk.ini. Settings change during play without input, and SAVE=1 rewrites the file.
0 skips the compare against one-block tiles when a texture's memory layout is chosen. The code calls it a negative control for fresh sessions; the comment does not say what the picture does.
Hot pools at most this many 2 MiB regions apart share one write-watch query. Changes the number of queries per submission; negative values count as 0.
Folder that holds one subfolder per player mod, beside totk.exe. Mods found there replace game files; see docs/mods.md.
Names of mods that are switched off, separated by \|. Listed mods are not applied; the Mods tab writes this line.

Names of mods used without their code part, separated by \|; the Mods tab's switch "Use ... without its code" writes it. A listed mod's code modules and the ExeFS patch files the port cannot apply are left out and the rest of the mod loads, where otherwise the whole mod stays off. Its files may expect the missing code.

Mod names, top first, separated by \|; the top mod wins a file, a byte of game data or an instruction of game code that two mods change. Changes which mod's file, data or code the game gets, at the next start; unlisted mods go below the listed ones, by name.

Folder with the player's mods, one subfolder per mod (<name>/romfs, <name>/exefs, <name>/cheats). Default: mods next to totk.exe. mods_dir = Load order, top first, names separated by |. The in-game menu (Mods) writes it; a mod not listed goes to the bottom. The higher mod wins whatever two mods both change: a file, bytes of the game's data, an instruction of its code. Read at start. mods_order = Mods switched off, names separated by |. mods_disabled = Mods used without their code part, names separated by |: the Mods tab's switch "Use <mod> without its code". Such a mod's code modules (exefs/subsdk*, a replaced exefs/main) and the ExeFS patch files the port cannot apply are left out and the rest of it is used, where otherwise the whole mod stays off. Read at start. mods_no_code = auto: when an enabled mod has cheats that change the game's code and the game was built without them, the game starts the setup's rebuild at start (a few minutes) and starts again after it. off: the game starts with the code it has. A rebuild that failed or was cancelled is not started again for the same cheats. Default: auto.
1 uses every mod without its code part, as if mods_no_code named them all. See mods_no_code.

desc.en: Aiming with the controller's gyroscope.
desc.ru: Прицеливание гироскопом контроллера.
desc.pt-BR: Mirar com o giroscópio do controle.
desc.zh-Hans: 用手柄的陀螺仪瞄准。

settings.doc: Gamepad motion controls (0 = off) and vibration (0 = off).

The mouse's camera motion times this while the bow is drawn (0.1 to 3; mouse_mode = direct, game 1.4.3), on top of the 0.08 degrees per count every camera turns, the bow's included. Changes while the game runs.

desc.en: Direct: the camera turns by how far the mouse moves, as in a PC game, with no stick dead zone or curve (games 1.4.3 and 1.2.1; 1.1.0 uses stick emulation). Stick emulation: the mouse acts as the right stick.
desc.ru: Прямое: камера поворачивается на столько, на сколько сдвинута мышь, как в играх для ПК, без мёртвой зоны и кривой стика (версии игры 1.4.3 и 1.2.1; на 1.1.0 эмуляция стика). Эмуляция стика: мышь работает как правый стик.
desc.pt-BR: Direta: a câmera gira o quanto o mouse se move, como num jogo de PC, sem zona morta nem curva do analógico (jogos 1.4.3 e 1.2.1; o 1.1.0 usa a emulação do analógico). Emulação do analógico: o mouse age como o analógico direito.
desc.zh-Hans: 直接：镜头按鼠标移动的距离转动，与电脑游戏相同，没有摇杆死区和响应曲线（游戏 1.4.3 和 1.2.1；1.1.0 使用摇杆模拟）。摇杆模拟：鼠标相当于右摇杆。

settings.doc: Mouse camera mode: direct (default) or stick. Direct turns the camera by the raw mouse motion, the same on both axes, with no stick dead zone or response curve (games 1.4.3 and 1.2.1; 1.1.0 uses stick emulation). Stick makes the mouse a right stick. Neither changes the gamepad. The Controls tab changes this while the game runs.
Patch set of the hooks in the game's camera code behind mouse_mode = direct on game 1.4.3. 0 stops mouse_mode = direct from taking effect; other mouse modes are unaffected.

desc.en: How fast the mouse turns the camera.
desc.ru: Как быстро мышь поворачивает камеру.
desc.pt-BR: Quão rápido o mouse gira a câmera.
desc.zh-Hans: 鼠标转动视角的速度。

settings.doc: Mouse camera sensitivity (0 to 10; 0 = no mouse camera and no cursor capture). With mouse_mode = direct, 1 turns the camera 0.08 degrees per count, the same in every camera mode (about 14.3 cm a turn at 800 DPI).

desc.en: When the game resolution is not 16:9, keep the cutscene movies' own shape with black bars, or stretch them over the whole picture. Applies from the next movie.
desc.ru: Когда разрешение игры не 16:9: сохранить форму роликов с чёрными полосами или растянуть их на всю картинку. Действует со следующего ролика.
desc.pt-BR: Quando a resolução do jogo não é 16:9: manter o formato dos vídeos das cenas com barras pretas ou esticá-los sobre a imagem toda. Vale a partir do próximo vídeo.
desc.zh-Hans: 当游戏分辨率不是 16:9 时：用黑边保持过场视频的原有比例，或拉伸铺满整个画面。从下一段视频起生效。

settings.doc: Shape of the pre-rendered movies (16:9) when the game resolution (output_res) is not 16:9: keep, the default, draws them in their own shape with black bars at the sides or above and below; stretch fills the whole picture, as the game does. Read when a movie starts, so a change takes effect at the next movie.
0 leaves every movie decoder to the game's own library. The code comment says that library aborts at the first movie, so the game stops at the first cutscene.
0 hands every decoded movie frame over at the next present instead of when it is due. Movies play at the game's frame rate rather than their own, so their speed no longer matches the sound.
1 also lists draws for object motion that read no object blocks (terrain and grass). More draws are checked and listed, which costs time.
1 logs which words of the other uniform banks changed for each scene draw. Adds log output and per-draw work.

1 uses an EQUAL depth compare for the object motion pass, for comparison. Changes which pixels get object vectors; the code comment names the default as the one that hides objects behind nearer geometry.
Hex bank mask; only draws whose position uses exactly these banks get object motion. Fewer draws get object vectors, so their motion falls back to the camera's.
0 lists object motion draws but never records them. Objects get camera motion only.
1 draws again positions that have no scene camera bank. Those draws get this frame's view, so they can show wrong motion.
Hex bank mask; only draws whose position reads no bank outside the mask get object motion. Fewer draws get object vectors.
1 adds timings to the object-motion summary. The clock reads themselves cost frame time.
1 verifies the stored first bytes of each previous-frame table entry. The code comment measures 3.6 ms per frame.
0 keeps only three banks in the previous-frame tables. Object motion that depends on the other banks is no longer tracked.
Hex bank mask of banks left out of the previous-frame copy, replacing the default. Different banks are tracked, which changes object motion.
Hex bank mask of banks whose found previous-frame copy is taken without the check. A copy that does not match is used anyway, which can give wrong motion.

Frame interval; every that many DLSS frames copies the light target and motion images to host memory and logs how well the vectors explain the picture. Costs a GPU-to-host copy and a comparison on the completion thread at each interval.
1 notes the uniform blocks of each scene draw and compares them with those of earlier frames. Adds per-draw work and log output.

1 keeps the process on the first logical processor of each physical core; ab switches it with the ab blocks. Busy threads stop sharing a core with a sibling thread, which can help or hurt on the CPU; it only applies when the CPU has hyperthreads.

desc.en: Whether the game thinks it runs docked or handheld.
desc.ru: Игра считает, что консоль в док-станции или в портативном режиме.
desc.pt-BR: Se o jogo acha que está no modo TV ou no modo portátil.
desc.zh-Hans: 游戏认为自己处于底座模式还是掌机模式。

settings.doc: System mode reported to the game: docked or handheld.

Patch set that treats a negative value in the optional reference at object +0x6b0 (1.4.3 main+0x1bd01c0, 1.2.1 main+0x1622bec) as absent instead of loading through it (#1005). 0 runs the game's code as shipped: the random crash reading 0xffffffffffffffff after minutes to hours of play can return.

desc.en: The size the game draws its picture and interface in. Above 1920 x 1080 the game needs more video memory and GPU time. A wider size (21:9) widens the camera's view and moves the HUD to the screen's corners; a taller one (16:10, 3:2) moves it to the top and bottom edges.
desc.ru: Размер, в котором игра рисует картинку и интерфейс. Выше 1920 × 1080 игре нужно больше видеопамяти и времени GPU. Более широкий размер (21:9) расширяет обзор камеры и переносит интерфейс в углы экрана, более высокий (16:10, 3:2) переносит его к верхнему и нижнему краям.
desc.pt-BR: O tamanho em que o jogo desenha a imagem e a interface. Acima de 1920 x 1080 o jogo precisa de mais memória de vídeo e tempo de GPU. Um tamanho mais largo (21:9) amplia a visão da câmera e leva o HUD para os cantos da tela; um mais alto (16:10, 3:2) leva-o para as bordas de cima e de baixo.
desc.zh-Hans: 游戏绘制画面和界面的尺寸。高于 1920 x 1080 会占用更多显存和 GPU 时间。更宽的尺寸（21:9）会扩大视野，并把界面移到屏幕四角；更高的尺寸（16:10、3:2）则移到上下边缘。

settings.doc: Game resolution: the size the game draws its picture and interface in (1280x720 to 7680x4320). Above 1920x1080 the game's texture heap and memory pool grow with it. Another shape than 16:9, such as 3440x1440 on a 21:9 monitor or the Steam Deck's 1280x800 (16:10), gives the camera's view that shape and lays the HUD out for it. The installer prepares the UI layout for fifteen sizes: 2560x1080, 3440x1440, 3840x1600, 5120x2160 (21:9), 3840x1080, 5120x1440 (32:9), 1280x800, 1680x1050, 1920x1200, 2560x1600 (16:10), 1920x1280, 2160x1440, 2256x1504, 2880x1920 and 3000x2000 (3:2). For any other size, or a source build that has not made the layout, the game draws the largest 16:9 size that fits inside it (3440x1080 gives 1920x1080) and the present adds bars; build the layout with tools/make_romfs_patches.py --aspect WxH to use the full shape. Read at start. Default: 1920x1080, or on a primary display of one of those shapes the smallest of its sizes at least 1080 high that fits the display (1920x1280 on a 3:2 laptop, 2560x1080 on a 21:9 monitor), so the picture fills the screen without black bars, with prompts = xbox or pc too (on an install by an older setup, which built the Xbox prompts for 16:9 only, prompts = xbox keeps 1920x1080).

desc.en: Which button is A. Nintendo: the right one, as on a Switch. Xbox: the bottom one, as labelled on an Xbox controller (cross on a PlayStation controller). Automatic picks Nintendo for controllers with Nintendo labels and Xbox for the others. Which controller the game's prompts show is set under Button prompts.
desc.ru: Какая кнопка работает как A. Nintendo: правая, как на Switch. Xbox: нижняя, как подписано на контроллере Xbox (крест на контроллере PlayStation). Автоматически: Nintendo для контроллеров с подписями Nintendo, Xbox для остальных. Кнопки какого контроллера показывают подсказки игры, задаётся в строке «Подсказки кнопок».
desc.pt-BR: Qual botão é o A. Nintendo: o da direita, como no Switch. Xbox: o de baixo, como indicado no controle de Xbox (cruz no controle de PlayStation). Automático escolhe Nintendo para controles com os rótulos da Nintendo e Xbox para os demais. Ícones de Xbox: o A é o da direita, como no Nintendo, e o jogo mostra os rótulos do Xbox (B no lugar de A, A no lugar de B, Y no lugar de X, X no lugar de Y); os ícones mudam após reiniciar. As letras fazem parte dos arquivos do jogo, então um botão remapeado em Controles continua com a letra antiga na tela.
desc.zh-Hans: 哪个按键是 A。Nintendo：右侧按键，与 Switch 相同。Xbox：下方按键，与 Xbox 手柄上的标注一致（PlayStation 手柄上为叉键）。自动：带 Nintendo 标注的手柄使用 Nintendo 布局，其他手柄使用 Xbox 布局。Xbox 按键提示：A 仍是右侧键，但游戏显示 Xbox 标注（A 显示为 B、B 显示为 A、X 显示为 Y、Y 显示为 X），重启后生效。这些字母来自游戏文件，因此在“操作”中重映射过的按键，屏幕上仍显示原来的字母。

settings.doc: Which gamepad button is Switch A: nintendo (by position: east A, south B, west Y, north X), xbox (south A, east B, west X, north Y, as an Xbox pad labels them; cross A on a PlayStation pad) or auto (nintendo for a pad with Nintendo labels, xbox for the others). The bind_ lines below apply on top. Changes while the game runs take effect at once. 0.1.9's xbox_prompts is read as nintendo with prompts = xbox.

desc.en: After a GPU crash, the log names the render pass that was running. Automatic: AMD only. On: also NVIDIA, at a small cost.
desc.ru: После сбоя GPU журнал называет проход отрисовки, который выполнялся. Автоматически: только AMD. Вкл.: также NVIDIA, с небольшой нагрузкой.
desc.pt-BR: Após uma falha da GPU, o log indica a passagem de renderização que estava em execução. Automático: só AMD. Ligado: também NVIDIA, com um pequeno custo.
desc.zh-Hans: GPU 崩溃后，日志会写出当时正在运行的渲染通道。自动：仅 AMD。开：NVIDIA 也启用，有少量开销。

settings.doc: GPU pass marks: after a GPU crash (device lost) the log names the render pass or dispatch the GPU had started and the last one it finished. Unset: on AMD GPUs (VK_AMD_buffer_marker). 1: also on NVIDIA GPUs (VK_NV_device_diagnostic_checkpoints), which NVIDIA says costs a little. 0: off.

Patch set that makes the game use the configured output size for its swapchain and display configuration. The resolution code switches this set whenever the output differs from the base size; a manual value is replaced.
Patch set that makes the game use the configured scene render size. The resolution code switches this set from the render size setting; a manual value is replaced.

On a hybrid CPU (performance and efficiency cores), the game's main and render threads and the replay, recorder and present threads prefer the performance cores; 0 turns that off. With 0 Windows may run those threads on efficiency cores; no effect on a CPU with one kind of core. The log says which cores were found.

desc.en: Sun shadows sharp where an object meets the ground and softer the further the shadow falls (PCSS). 0 keeps the game's filter. Takes effect at the next start.
desc.ru: Тени от солнца резкие там, где предмет касается земли, и мягче, чем дальше падает тень (PCSS). 0 оставляет фильтр игры. Действует после перезапуска.
desc.pt-BR: Sombras do sol nítidas onde um objeto toca o chão e mais suaves quanto mais longe a sombra cai (PCSS). 0 mantém o filtro do jogo. Vale no próximo início.
desc.zh-Hans: 物体接触地面处的太阳阴影锐利，阴影投得越远越柔和（PCSS）。0 保留游戏自身的过滤。下次启动时生效。

settings.doc: Soft sun shadows (PCSS), percent of the default penumbra width (0 to 200; 0 = the game's own four-tap filter): sharp where an object meets the ground and softer the further its shadow falls. Done in the translated shaders (translator patch 0010), so the shader cache is rebuilt once after an update. Read at start.
Depth-to-penumbra factor of soft shadows at 100 percent, for tuning. Changes how wide soft shadows blur; has no effect while pcss is 0.

desc.en: Frame rate in the top right corner. Full adds frame times with a graph, CPU, GPU and memory load, temperatures and the render thread's waits. F10 cycles the modes.
desc.ru: Частота кадров в правом верхнем углу. «Полный» добавляет время кадров с графиком, загрузку ЦП, GPU и памяти, температуры и ожидания потока отрисовки. F10 переключает режимы.
desc.pt-BR: Taxa de quadros no canto superior direito. Completo adiciona os tempos de quadro com gráfico, o uso de CPU, GPU e memória, as temperaturas e as esperas da thread de renderização. F10 alterna os modos.
desc.zh-Hans: 在右上角显示帧率。“完整”还会显示带图表的帧时间、CPU、GPU 和内存占用、温度，以及渲染线程的等待时间。按 F10 循环切换模式。

settings.doc: Performance overlay in the top right corner: off, fps, or full (frame rate, mean and longest frame time). F10 cycles the modes in game, as do both stick clicks (L3 + R3) on a controller.
Frames at least this many milliseconds long get a perf: slow frame log line with the time blocked per cause. Changes how many frames are logged; a small value fills the log.
Path of the Vulkan pipeline cache file (default pipeline-cache.bin beside totk.exe). Moves the cache; a new path starts empty and pipelines are built again.

desc.en: Optimisation: reuses the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats.
desc.ru: Оптимизация: повторяет конвейер прошлой отрисовки, если её состояние не изменилось.
desc.pt-BR: Otimização: reaproveita o pipeline do desenho anterior quando o estado se repete.
desc.zh-Hans: 优化：状态重复时复用上一次绘制的管线。

settings.doc: Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk, skip push constants that did not change, bind only the vertex buffers a draw reads, compare and copy each draw's state inline, and rebuild only the parts of a draw's bindings, shaders and pipeline whose inputs changed since the draw before (check: build everything and log any difference from what would have been kept).

desc.en: Builds known pipelines ahead of time.
desc.ru: Заранее собирает известные конвейеры.
desc.pt-BR: Monta antes os pipelines conhecidos.
desc.zh-Hans: 提前构建已知的管线。

settings.doc: Build known pipelines ahead of time.

label.en: Draws skipped while a pipeline builds
label.zh-Hans: 构建管线时跳过的绘制

desc.en: Which draws are dropped instead of waiting for their pipeline.
desc.ru: Какие отрисовки отбрасываются, а не ждут свой конвейер.
desc.pt-BR: Quais desenhos são descartados em vez de esperar pelo seu pipeline.
desc.zh-Hans: 哪些绘制会被直接丢弃，而不是等待其管线构建完成。

settings.doc: Which draws are dropped instead of waiting for their pipeline: strict (only draws into per-frame passes), any (also draws into passes whose target the previous frame rendered) or fullscreen (those and full-screen draws).
Any value other than 0 or empty stops graphics pipelines from being built in the background. Pipelines are built on the render path, which causes stutter when new effects appear.

desc.en: Default keeps the current scheduling with a reserved worker for waiting draws; Old (draw) uses the previous scheduling.
desc.ru: «По умолчанию» — текущее планирование с отдельным потоком для ожидающих отрисовок; «Старый способ» — прежнее планирование.
desc.pt-BR: Padrão mantém o agendamento atual, com um worker reservado para desenhos em espera; Antigo (draw) usa o agendamento anterior.
desc.zh-Hans: 默认保留当前调度，并为等待中的绘制预留一个工作线程；旧版（绘制）沿用先前的调度。

settings.doc: Shaders and pipelines. Draws whose pipeline is still building: default waits on a reserved worker; draw is the previous scheduling.

Added to every GetSystemTick in the plugin service run (totk.exe --plugin-init DIR), so tools/exefs_plugins.py can run a plugin's init twice with other ticks and compare the records. Has no effect outside --plugin-init; a plugin's init at the start of the game gets the plain ticks.

1 logs the first call of each entry of a mod plugin's hooks (its callbacks, replace and call targets) as plugins: hook entry ... reached. Each such call goes through a counting step; nothing changes without a mod plugin.

desc.en: While the cursor is not captured (the game's menus, this menu, after Esc), the window shows a gold arrowhead of its own instead of the system arrow, sized for the screen's scale.
desc.ru: Пока курсор не захвачен (меню игры, это меню, после Esc), окно показывает собственный золотой наконечник вместо системной стрелки, по масштабу экрана.
desc.pt-BR: Enquanto o cursor não está capturado (os menus do jogo, este menu, depois de Esc), a janela mostra uma ponta de flecha dourada própria em vez da seta do sistema, no tamanho da escala da tela.
desc.zh-Hans: 光标未被捕获时（游戏菜单、本菜单、按 Esc 之后），窗口显示自带的金色箭头，而不是系统箭头，大小随屏幕缩放。

settings.doc: The mouse pointer over the game window while the cursor is not captured (the game's menus, the settings menu, after Esc). 1: a gold arrowhead with a dark edge and a turquoise gem, drawn by the port at the window's DPI, instead of the system arrow. 0 (the default) keeps the system arrow. Changes while the game runs.

desc.en: Threads that translate known shaders at start; Automatic takes half the CPU threads, at most 16.
desc.ru: Потоки, которые при запуске переводят известные шейдеры; «Автоматически» — половина потоков процессора, не больше 16.
desc.pt-BR: Threads que traduzem os shaders conhecidos ao iniciar; Automático usa metade das threads da CPU, no máximo 16.
desc.zh-Hans: 启动时转译已知着色器的线程数；自动取 CPU 线程数的一半，最多 16。

settings.doc: Threads that translate known shaders at start (1 to 64; default: half the CPU threads, at most 16).
Text that picks the movie for totk.exe --probe-movie: the first file whose path contains it. Only used by the movie decoder probe; ignored in normal play.
1 makes the movie probe also time the resampler that fits a movie to a game resolution of another shape, and print the time per frame. Only used by the movie decoder probe.
Path of a .ppm file that the movie probe writes the middle frame to. Only used by the movie decoder probe.
Path of a sampling profile file; the profiler suspends threads to unwind their stacks. Frames get slower while it samples and the profile file grows; tools/prof_report.py reads it.
1 keeps call chains of every thread in the profile. Larger profile file and more work per sample; has no effect without profile.

Folder of the game profile, which holds the user account id that save data is named after; the default is a profile folder beside totk.exe, else the build-time path. Another folder means a different set of saves.
<lo>-<hi> samples only while presents lo to hi-1 are pending; w<lo>-<hi> uses world-clock seconds. Limits the profile to a window; has no effect without profile.
1 samples only the guest main thread. Narrows the profile; has no effect without profile.
1 samples only the render thread and keeps its call chains. Narrows the profile and makes it larger; has no effect without profile.

desc.en: Which controller's buttons the game's prompts show. Nintendo: the game's own. Xbox: LB, RB, LT, RT, Menu, View and a d-pad cross, and A, B, X and Y as labelled on the button the layout above presses (with Nintendo (A right) the right button is labelled B, so the prompts for A show B). PC: the keys and mouse buttons of the keyboard's default layout (E, Shift, Space, left click...) and the mouse for the camera. The game reads its prompts at start, so they change after a restart. They are part of the game's files, so a button you remap in Controls keeps its old prompt on screen.
desc.ru: Кнопки какого контроллера показывают подсказки игры. Nintendo: как в самой игре. Xbox: LB, RB, LT, RT, Menu, View и крестовина, а A, B, X и Y подписаны так же, как кнопка, которую нажимает раскладка выше (в Nintendo (A справа) правая кнопка подписана B, и подсказки A показывают B). PC: клавиши и кнопки мыши стандартной раскладки клавиатуры (E, Shift, пробел, левый клик...) и мышь для камеры. Игра читает подсказки при запуске, так что они меняются после перезапуска. Подсказки записаны в файлах игры, поэтому у кнопки, переназначенной на вкладке управления, на экране остаётся прежняя подсказка.
desc.pt-BR: Os botões de qual controle os ícones do jogo mostram. Nintendo: os do próprio jogo. Xbox: LB, RB, LT, RT, Menu, Exibir e uma cruz direcional, e A, B, X e Y com a letra do botão que o layout acima aperta (com Nintendo (A à direita) o botão da direita tem a letra B, então os ícones de A mostram B). PC: as teclas e os botões do mouse do layout padrão do teclado (E, Shift, Espaço, clique esquerdo...) e o mouse para a câmera. O jogo lê os ícones ao iniciar, então eles mudam depois de reiniciar. Eles fazem parte dos arquivos do jogo, então um botão remapeado em Controles continua com o ícone antigo na tela.
desc.zh-Hans: 游戏的按键提示显示哪种手柄的按键。Nintendo：游戏原有的提示。Xbox：LB、RB、LT、RT、Menu、View 和十字键，以及上方布局所按下的按键上标注的 A、B、X、Y（使用 Nintendo（A 在右）时右侧按键标为 B，因此 A 的提示显示 B）。PC：键盘默认布局的按键和鼠标按键（E、Shift、空格、左键……），镜头用鼠标。游戏在启动时读取按键提示，因此重启后才会改变。提示属于游戏文件，在“操作”中重新映射的按键在屏幕上仍显示原来的提示。

settings.doc: The buttons the game's prompts show: nintendo (the game's own), xbox (LB RB LT RT, Menu, View and a d-pad cross, and A B X Y as labelled on the button pad_layout presses: with nintendo, A shows as B and X as Y). Read at start (docs/controls.md, "Xbox button prompts"). pc: the key or mouse button the keyboard defaults press each button with (E, Shift, Space, left click, Q, R, right click, F, Tab, M, 1 to 4, W A S D, Ctrl, C) and the mouse for the right stick, whatever pad_layout (docs/controls.md, "PC button prompts").

desc.en: Optimisation: skips push constants that did not change.
desc.ru: Оптимизация: пропускает неизменившиеся push-константы.
desc.pt-BR: Otimização: pula push constants que não mudaram.
desc.zh-Hans: 优化：跳过没有变化的推送常量。

settings.doc: Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk, skip push constants that did not change, bind only the vertex buffers a draw reads, compare and copy each draw's state inline, and rebuild only the parts of a draw's bindings, shaders and pipeline whose inputs changed since the draw before (check: build everything and log any difference from what would have been kept).
fs pushes the descriptor set from the fragment stage instead of the vertex stage. The log names the stage in use; the code does not say what changes in the picture.

desc.en: The key that starts quick save or quick load; F6 and F7 by default, as in Half-Life. Select the cell and press any key or mouse button; Delete leaves that one without a key. While quick save is on, the two keys do nothing else (a note shows when a binding also uses the key). totk.ini takes any key name of the bindings (quicksave_key, quickload_key).
desc.ru: Клавиша, которая запускает быстрое сохранение или быструю загрузку; по умолчанию F6 и F7, как в Half-Life. Выберите ячейку и нажмите любую клавишу или кнопку мыши; Delete оставляет действие без клавиши. Пока быстрое сохранение включено, эти две клавиши больше ничего не делают (если клавиша занята в раскладке, это написано под значением). В totk.ini подходит любое имя клавиши из раскладки (quicksave_key, quickload_key).
desc.pt-BR: A tecla que inicia o salvamento ou o carregamento rápido; F6 e F7 por padrão, como no Half-Life. Selecione a célula e aperte qualquer tecla ou botão do mouse; Delete deixa essa ação sem tecla. Com o salvamento rápido ligado, as duas teclas não fazem mais nada (uma nota aparece quando um mapeamento também usa a tecla). O totk.ini aceita qualquer nome de tecla dos mapeamentos (quicksave_key, quickload_key).
desc.zh-Hans: 启动快速存档或快速读档的按键；默认 F6 和 F7，与 Half-Life 相同。选中该格后按下任意键盘按键或鼠标按键；按 Delete 则该操作没有按键。快速存档开启时，这两个键不再有其他作用（若按键映射也使用该键，值下方会有提示）。totk.ini 接受按键映射中的任意按键名（quicksave_key、quickload_key）。

settings.doc: The key of quick load with quicksave = 1, as quicksave_key; an unknown name is logged and f7 is used, the same key as quicksave_key leaves loading without a key. While quicksave = 1 the key reaches no binding; it reloads the quick save, losing the progress since.

desc.en: One key saves the game at once and another loads that save (the two rows below: F6 and F7 by default, as in Half-Life), with no menu on the screen. Keyboard and mouse keys only, game 1.4.3 only. Quick save asks the game for one of its own autosaves, so it replaces the oldest autosave (the manual save stays), keeps a copy of it as the quick save (the quicksave folder of the profile) and shows "Game saved" at the top of the picture. Quick load holds the picture on "Loading the quick save" while it goes through the game's load list out of sight, and the game loads the quick save (about 5 s). Where the game would not make an autosave itself (a cutscene, a dialogue), nothing is saved and the line says so.
desc.ru: Одна клавиша сразу сохраняет игру, другая загружает это сохранение (две строки ниже: по умолчанию F6 и F7, как в Half-Life), без всяких меню на экране. Только клавиатура и мышь, только версия игры 1.4.3. Быстрое сохранение просит игру сделать одно из её собственных автосохранений, поэтому заменяет самое старое автосохранение (ручное сохранение остаётся), держит его копию как быстрое сохранение (папка quicksave профиля) и пишет «Игра сохранена» вверху экрана. Быстрая загрузка держит картинку с надписью «Загрузка быстрого сохранения», пока за кадром проходит список загрузки игры, и игра загружает быстрое сохранение (около 5 с). Где игра сама не стала бы автосохраняться (сценка, диалог), ничего не сохраняется, и надпись говорит об этом.
desc.pt-BR: Uma tecla salva o jogo na hora e outra carrega esse salvamento (as duas linhas abaixo: F6 e F7 por padrão, como no Half-Life), sem nenhum menu na tela. Só teclado e mouse, só o jogo 1.4.3. O salvamento rápido pede ao jogo um dos seus próprios salvamentos automáticos, então substitui o salvamento automático mais antigo (o salvamento manual fica), guarda uma cópia dele como salvamento rápido (a pasta quicksave do perfil) e mostra "Jogo salvo" no alto da imagem. O carregamento rápido segura a imagem em "Carregando o salvamento rápido" enquanto passa pela lista de carregamento do jogo fora de vista, e o jogo carrega o salvamento rápido (cerca de 5 s). Onde o próprio jogo não faria um salvamento automático (uma cena, um diálogo), nada é salvo e a linha avisa.
desc.zh-Hans: 一个键立即保存游戏，另一个键读取该存档（见下方两行：默认 F6 和 F7，与 Half-Life 相同），屏幕上不会出现任何菜单。仅限键盘和鼠标按键，仅限游戏 1.4.3。快速存档会让游戏自己进行一次自动存档，因此会替换最旧的自动存档（手动存档保留），并将其副本保存为快速存档（配置文件中的 quicksave 文件夹），画面顶部显示“游戏已保存”。快速读档时画面停留在“正在读取快速存档”，同时在后台走完游戏的读档列表，游戏随即读取快速存档（约 5 秒）。在游戏本身不会自动存档的地方（过场动画、对话），不会保存，并会显示提示。

settings.doc: 1: quicksave_key makes one of the game's autosaves at once and keeps a copy as the quick save (<profile>/quicksave), quickload_key loads that copy (runtime/quicksave.c, game 1.4.3, keyboard and mouse keys only; docs/controls.md, "Quick save"). No menu shows; a line at the top of the picture says *Game saved* or why nothing was saved. Quick save takes one of the game's autosave slots and so replaces the oldest autosave, as the game's own autosaves do (the manual save stays); quick load (about 5 s, the picture held while it runs the game's load list underneath) reloads the quick save, losing the progress since.

desc.en: The key that starts quick save or quick load; F6 and F7 by default, as in Half-Life. Select the cell and press any key or mouse button; Delete leaves that one without a key. While quick save is on, the two keys do nothing else (a note shows when a binding also uses the key). totk.ini takes any key name of the bindings (quicksave_key, quickload_key).
desc.ru: Клавиша, которая запускает быстрое сохранение или быструю загрузку; по умолчанию F6 и F7, как в Half-Life. Выберите ячейку и нажмите любую клавишу или кнопку мыши; Delete оставляет действие без клавиши. Пока быстрое сохранение включено, эти две клавиши больше ничего не делают (если клавиша занята в раскладке, это написано под значением). В totk.ini подходит любое имя клавиши из раскладки (quicksave_key, quickload_key).
desc.pt-BR: A tecla que inicia o salvamento ou o carregamento rápido; F6 e F7 por padrão, como no Half-Life. Selecione a célula e aperte qualquer tecla ou botão do mouse; Delete deixa essa ação sem tecla. Com o salvamento rápido ligado, as duas teclas não fazem mais nada (uma nota aparece quando um mapeamento também usa a tecla). O totk.ini aceita qualquer nome de tecla dos mapeamentos (quicksave_key, quickload_key).
desc.zh-Hans: 启动快速存档或快速读档的按键；默认 F6 和 F7，与 Half-Life 相同。选中该格后按下任意键盘按键或鼠标按键；按 Delete 则该操作没有按键。快速存档开启时，这两个键不再有其他作用（若按键映射也使用该键，值下方会有提示）。totk.ini 接受按键映射中的任意按键名（quicksave_key、quickload_key）。

settings.doc: The key of quick save with quicksave = 1: a key name of the remapping list (docs/controls.md, "Remapping") or none; an unknown name is logged and f6 is used. While quicksave = 1 the key reaches no binding.

Comma-separated frame numbers to capture with RenderDoc, which is loaded before Vulkan starts. The game runs under RenderDoc, with its capture options set to keep VK_EXT_external_memory_host available and to reference all resources, and captures are written to disk.
Output folder for RenderDoc captures (the default is build/captures). Only moves the output.
Path of the RenderDoc library, for when it is not found by default. A wrong path logs that the library cannot be loaded and no capture is taken.

desc.en: Steps the game by real time, so a slow frame does not slow the game down.
desc.ru: Игра идёт по реальному времени, медленный кадр её не замедляет.
desc.pt-BR: Avança o jogo pelo tempo real, para que um quadro lento não deixe o jogo mais lento.
desc.zh-Hans: 按真实时间推进游戏，帧率低时游戏速度也不会变慢。

settings.doc: Real-time frame step: game speed follows the clock instead of the frame count.

0 makes the submitting thread wait until the recorder thread has recorded and submitted each part; ab alternates with the ab blocks. With 0 the submitting thread waits for every part (about 0.3 ms a frame in a town on a Ryzen 7900X).
0 lets the submitting thread begin, end and submit a recorded part again, as older versions did. On some AMD cards the GPU hangs or the scene turns green and then white when a submission is split.

Microseconds the recorder thread polls for the next packets before it sleeps; 0 polls 4096 pauses instead; ab polls only in the B blocks of ab. With fewer than 6 logical processors it always polls 4096 pauses. A longer poll saves an OS wake-up per packet and takes more CPU time; a shorter one sleeps sooner.

Counter of address-space retries that the runtime sets itself when it starts the process again. The counter is cleared when the window is recreated; a value of 20 or more stops the start with a fatal error.

desc.en: Reduces system latency on NVIDIA GPUs using VK_NV_low_latency2. On + Boost keeps GPU clocks high in CPU-bound scenes.
desc.ru: Снижает задержку системы на видеокартах NVIDIA с помощью VK_NV_low_latency2. «Вкл + Ускорение» удерживает высокие частоты GPU при упоре в процессор.
desc.pt-BR: Reduz a latência do sistema em GPUs NVIDIA usando VK_NV_low_latency2. Ligado + Boost mantém os clocks da GPU altos quando limitado pela CPU.
desc.zh-Hans: 在支持 VK_NV_low_latency2 的 NVIDIA 显卡上降低系统延迟。开 + 增强 (On + Boost) 会在 CPU 瓶颈时保持 GPU 高频率。

settings.doc: off, on, or boost; enables NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency (VK_NV_low_latency2) to reduce system input latency. Read at start. On NVIDIA GPUs supporting the extension, coordinates simulation and presentation cadence to lower latency, holding frames to the frame limit the pacer uses (fps_limit, the monitor's rate for display); boost keeps GPU clocks high in CPU-bound scenes. Has no effect on non-NVIDIA GPUs.

desc.en: Size of the 3D scene relative to the game resolution; the game's FSR scales it to that size. Above 100 % smooths jagged edges (supersampling) at a high GPU cost.
desc.ru: Размер 3D-сцены относительно разрешения игры; FSR игры доводит её до этого размера. Выше 100 % сглаживает лесенки на краях (суперсэмплинг) ценой большой нагрузки на GPU.
desc.pt-BR: Tamanho da cena 3D em relação à resolução do jogo; o FSR do jogo a amplia até esse tamanho. Acima de 100 % suaviza bordas serrilhadas (supersampling) com alto custo de GPU.
desc.zh-Hans: 3D 场景相对于游戏分辨率的尺寸；游戏的 FSR 会将其缩放到该尺寸。高于 100% 会平滑锯齿边缘（超采样），但 GPU 开销很高。

settings.doc: 3D render scale: the scene's size relative to the game resolution, game (5/6, the game's own 1600x900 at 1080p) or a percentage (25 to 400); above 100 supersamples the scene (anti-aliasing). The scene stays within 8192 pixels a side and within a texture heap under 2 GiB (8192x2304 at most on a 5120x1440 output); the log says when it is smaller. Read at start.

label.en: GPU frame prep on its own thread
label.ru: Подготовка кадра для GPU в отдельном потоке
label.pt-BR: Preparo de quadro da GPU em thread própria

desc.en: Prepares frames for the GPU on a separate thread instead of the game thread. Adds up to one frame of latency.
desc.ru: Кадр для GPU готовится в отдельном потоке, а не в потоке игры. Добавляет до одного кадра задержки.
desc.pt-BR: Prepara os quadros para a GPU numa thread separada em vez da thread do jogo. Adiciona até um quadro de latência.
desc.zh-Hans: 在单独的线程而不是游戏线程上为 GPU 准备帧。最多增加一帧延迟。

settings.doc: Replay NVN submissions on their own thread, at most one frame behind the game, 0 or 1. Default: off. Helps where the game waits for the GPU; adds up to a frame of latency.

Most chunks a submission is cut into when replay_workers is set; 0 uses twice the number of recording threads. Fewer chunks leave threads idle at the end of a submission, more add scan and submit work per chunk; no effect while replay_workers is 0.
Least draws a chunk of the chunked replay holds before it may end at a pass. Small values make many short chunks, large ones leave big submissions on few threads; no effect while replay_workers is 0.

Debug: the even chunks of a chunked submission wait this many microseconds before they record, so the chunk after each one records first. Shows a recording that depends on which thread gets to a chunk first in every submission; slows the replay; no effect with fewer than 2 replay_workers.

1 compares the replay state after the last chunk of a chunked submission with the state of the scan and logs differences. Adds a comparison per submission and log lines on a mismatch; no effect while replay_workers is 0.

label.pt-BR: Threads de preparo de quadro da GPU

desc.en: Records large frames for the GPU on several threads at once. Helps when the CPU limits the frame rate; needs 8 or more logical processors. Off records on one thread.
desc.ru: Большие кадры для GPU записываются сразу в нескольких потоках. Помогает, когда частоту кадров ограничивает процессор; нужно 8 логических процессоров или больше. «Выкл.» — запись в одном потоке.
desc.pt-BR: Grava quadros grandes para a GPU em várias threads ao mesmo tempo. Ajuda quando a CPU limita a taxa de quadros; precisa de 8 ou mais processadores lógicos. Desligado grava numa thread só.
desc.zh-Hans: 同时在多个线程上为 GPU 录制大帧。CPU 限制帧率时有帮助；需要 8 个或更多逻辑处理器。关：在单个线程上录制。

settings.doc: Record each large submission in chunks on this many threads (0 to 16; 0 = one thread, the default). The chunks go to the GPU in order. In the town at 4K on an RTX 5070, 4 cut the replay from 8.2 to 4.5 ms a frame (71 to 79 fps); more threads add little. Needs 8 or more logical processors to help. Contact shadows and DLSS (dlaa = 1) run in chunks too. Read at start.

1 reads every texture read-back a second time after a full drain of the replay queue and compares the two. Stalls the replay queue at every read-back, so frames get much slower; mismatches are only counted and logged.

Patch set on 1.4.3 only: in the model scene's report loop (main+0xa22d8, main+0xa2310) an object whose report handle is negative or whose row index is 0x8000 or more gets coverage 0 for that frame and its handle reset, the path the game takes after every read, instead of reading past the report rows. On valid rows the game's code runs unchanged. 0 runs the game's code as shipped: a bad row index reads far past the rows and crashes, the class Weeping of the Empire met while using Ultrahand and aiming.
1 compares every cached pool lookup with the locked lookup and stops on a difference. Slows every pool lookup; the game stops if the two ever differ.

Set by the runtime when it restarts itself; names the old process by id and creation time so the new process waits for it to exit. Meant for the runtime's own use; the code does not describe a manual value.

Folder of the game's RomFS (with romfs.bin); a relative path is relative to totk.exe's folder. Without it, a romfs folder next to totk.exe is used, else the build-time path; a missing image stops the start with a message.
Path of romfs-index.bin, which tools/romfs_index.py wrote; the default is beside totk.exe. The index is checked against the image by SHA-256 and size; a mismatch stops the start.
1 maps the RomFS image into memory instead of reading it with positional reads. Changes how the image is read; the log reports when the mapped path is on.

Folder of an overlay with a manifest.tsv of sizes and SHA-256 hashes; its files are served in place of the originals. A missing file, size or hash mismatch, or a changed original stops the start; player mods win over this overlay.

Folder of an overlay with a manifest.tsv, served in place of the original files; the default is romfs-patches beside the index. Same checks as romfs_mods; while it is set the Xbox and PC button prompts are off, and the menu says so.
Folder for the .romfs-verified-v1 proof file of a full verification; the default is beside the index. Only moves one small file.
full hashes the whole RomFS image at start; force hashes it again even when a proof file exists. Start takes many minutes for a 17 GB image; a proof file is written so later starts skip the hash.

desc.en: How far a gamepad stick moves before the game sees it. Raise it if the character or the camera moves on its own: let go of the stick, read "stick now" and set the dead zone a few percent above it.
desc.ru: Насколько нужно отклонить стик геймпада, чтобы игра это заметила. Увеличьте, если персонаж или камера двигаются сами: отпустите стик, посмотрите «стик сейчас» и поставьте мёртвую зону на несколько процентов выше.
desc.pt-BR: Quanto um analógico do controle precisa se mover antes que o jogo perceba. Aumente se o personagem ou a câmera se moverem sozinhos: solte o analógico, leia "analógico agora" e coloque a zona morta alguns por cento acima.
desc.zh-Hans: 手柄摇杆要推动多远游戏才会响应。如果角色或视角会自己移动，请调高此值：松开摇杆，查看“当前摇杆”，把死区设得比它高几个百分点。

settings.doc: The dead zone of one stick, in place of stick_deadzone for that stick (0 to 50; unset = stick_deadzone). The Controls tab shows each stick's deflection now, so a drifting stick's resting value can be read off.

The measured bias in rad/s and the controller it was measured from, written by the game when calibration finishes; they are not meant to be typed. The bias applies only while gyro_bias_pad names the connected controller (its name, plus a hash of its serial number when it reports one), so another controller starts with no bias. One controller's bias is kept: calibrating another one replaces it.

desc.en: Lower values make weak vibration stronger.
desc.ru: Чем ниже значение, тем сильнее слабая вибрация.
desc.pt-BR: Valores menores deixam a vibração fraca mais forte.
desc.zh-Hans: 数值越低，弱振动越强。

settings.doc: Rumble strength in percent (0 to 300; 0 = off) and the exponent on the amplitude (0.2 to 1.5; lower = weak pulses stronger, 1 = linear). rumble_triggers = 1 also drives the impulse triggers of an Xbox pad.

desc.en: How strong the controller vibrates.
desc.ru: Насколько сильно вибрирует контроллер.
desc.pt-BR: Quão forte o controle vibra.
desc.zh-Hans: 手柄振动的强弱。

settings.doc: Rumble strength in percent (0 to 300; 0 = off) and the exponent on the amplitude (0.2 to 1.5; lower = weak pulses stronger, 1 = linear). rumble_triggers = 1 also drives the impulse triggers of an Xbox pad.

desc.en: Vibrates the triggers of an Xbox controller too.
desc.ru: Вибрация и в триггерах контроллера Xbox.
desc.pt-BR: Também vibra os gatilhos de um controle de Xbox.
desc.zh-Hans: Xbox 手柄的扳机也会振动。

settings.doc: Rumble strength in percent (0 to 300; 0 = off) and the exponent on the amplitude (0.2 to 1.5; lower = weak pulses stronger, 1 = linear). rumble_triggers = 1 also drives the impulse triggers of an Xbox pad.
Folder of the translated shader cache (default shader-cache beside totk.exe). A new folder starts empty, so shaders are translated again during play.

desc.en: Optimisation: remembers shader lookups.
desc.ru: Оптимизация: запоминает поиск шейдеров.
desc.pt-BR: Otimização: lembra as buscas de shaders.
desc.zh-Hans: 优化：记住着色器的查找结果。

settings.doc: Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk, skip push constants that did not change, bind only the vertex buffers a draw reads, compare and copy each draw's state inline, and rebuild only the parts of a draw's bindings, shaders and pipeline whose inputs changed since the draw before (check: build everything and log any difference from what would have been kept).

Shadow storage, 0 or 1: each CPU-visible memory pool of the game gets a host-visible copy that the GPU reads, in place of importing the game's memory. Default: on under Linux and Wine, off on native Windows. sync_ahead needs it. Costs about 0.2 ms a frame and doubles the memory of those pools (about 1.1 GB; docs/building.md). Read at start.

With sync_ahead = 1: when the game changes memory the GPU still reads, queue the copy into the GPU's shadow of that memory for the GPU to run in order, 0 or 1. Default: on. With 0 the replay thread waits for the GPU to finish reading instead, which costs part of the gain.

desc.en: Moves the steps where shadows turn softer (the game's 20, 40, 80 and 160 m) further away. Spreads the shadow map over more ground: raise Shadow resolution with it. Takes effect at the next start.
desc.ru: Отодвигает границы, за которыми тени становятся мягче (в игре 20, 40, 80 и 160 м). Карта теней растягивается на большую площадь, поэтому вместе с этим поднимайте разрешение теней. Действует после перезапуска.
desc.pt-BR: Afasta os degraus em que as sombras ficam mais suaves (20, 40, 80 e 160 m no jogo). Espalha o mapa de sombras por mais terreno: aumente a Resolução das sombras junto. Vale no próximo início.
desc.zh-Hans: 把阴影变柔和的分界（游戏中为 20、40、80 和 160 米）推得更远。阴影贴图会覆盖更大的地面，请同时提高阴影分辨率。下次启动时生效。

settings.doc: Sun shadow cascade range in percent of the game's (its cascades end at 20, 40, 80 and 160 m), 50 to 400: higher moves the steps where shadows turn softer further away, and spreads the shadow map over more ground. Read at start.

desc.en: Size of the sun's shadow map. The game's own size changes with the view, down to about 400 near the ground, so leaf shadows look blocky and jump; a fixed size keeps them still and sharper. Above 1024 the shadows cost more GPU time and video memory; 256 is coarser than the game's own and is for integrated GPUs short of memory bandwidth.
desc.ru: Размер карты теней от солнца. Собственный размер игры меняется вместе с видом, у земли до примерно 400, поэтому тени листвы выглядят квадратными и дёргаются; постоянный размер делает их ровными и чётче. Выше 1024 тени требуют больше времени GPU и видеопамяти; 256 грубее собственного размера игры и предназначен для встроенных GPU с нехваткой пропускной способности памяти.
desc.pt-BR: Tamanho do mapa de sombras do sol. O tamanho do jogo muda com a vista, até cerca de 400 perto do chão, então as sombras das folhas ficam quadriculadas e pulam; um tamanho fixo as deixa paradas e mais nítidas. Acima de 1024 as sombras custam mais tempo de GPU e memória de vídeo; 256 é mais grosseiro que o do jogo e serve para GPUs integradas com pouca largura de banda de memória.
desc.zh-Hans: 太阳阴影贴图的尺寸。游戏自身的尺寸随视角变化，靠近地面时降到约 400，因此树叶阴影显得块状并且跳动；固定尺寸能让阴影稳定、更清晰。高于 1024 时阴影会占用更多 GPU 时间和显存；256 比游戏自身的尺寸更粗糙，适合显存带宽不足的集成显卡。

settings.doc: Sun shadow map size: game (the game's own, which changes with the view and drops to about 400 near the ground, so leaf shadows look blocky and jump) or a fixed 256, 512, 768, 1024, 1536 or 2048. Above 960 the texture heap grows with it. 256 is coarser than the game's own and is for integrated GPUs short of memory bandwidth. Read at start.

desc.en: Draws the sun's shadow maps this many times larger on each side than the game's 960x960: sharper shadow edges and leaf shadows. Takes effect at the next start.
desc.ru: Карты теней от солнца рисуются во столько раз больше по каждой стороне, чем 960x960 самой игры: края теней и тени листвы чётче. Действует после перезапуска.
desc.pt-BR: Desenha os mapas de sombra do sol essa quantidade de vezes maiores em cada lado que os 960x960 do jogo: bordas de sombra e sombras de folhas mais nítidas. Vale no próximo início.
desc.zh-Hans: 将太阳阴影贴图的每条边绘制为游戏 960x960 的若干倍：阴影边缘和树叶阴影更清晰。下次启动时生效。

settings.doc: Shadow map resolution: the game's sun cascades are 960x960 (and its static shadow maps 1440 and 720) whatever the game resolution; 2 to 4 draws them that many times larger on each side, for sharper shadows. 1 = the game's. The game's shadow edge filter is narrowed by the same factor (translator patch 0011), so close shadow edges don't look doubled. Read at start.

Shadow storage (Linux, Wine): 1 syncs the pools from per-submission write-watch snapshots, each 2 MiB region queried at most once per submission and shared with the texture checks; 0 queries each pool at every part of a submission, as before. 1 cut the replay thread's write tracking from about 4.4 to 1.3 ms a frame on a Steam Deck; 0 is for comparison runs. Under Wine/Proton the default is 0 until it has been measured there; 1 turns it on. No effect where shadow storage is off (Windows by default).

Folder of the extracted system fonts; the default is shared-fonts beside totk.exe, else beside the RomFS. Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Korean need these fonts: without them the game exits before its first frame in those languages. Other languages do not use them.

desc.en: Sharpening after FSR scaling; 0 turns it off.
desc.ru: Повышение резкости после масштабирования FSR; 0 выключает его.
desc.pt-BR: Aumento de nitidez após a ampliação do FSR; 0 desliga.
desc.zh-Hans: FSR 缩放后的锐化强度；0 为关闭。

settings.doc: Scaling to the window when it is larger than the game resolution: fsr (AMD FSR 1) or bilinear, and FSR's sharpening from 0 (off) to 100. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.

<lo>-<hi>:<step> saves every step-th present in the range as f<n>.png, scaled to 480x270; w<lo>-<hi>:<step> takes them by world-clock seconds. Writes one PNG per step and adds a readback of the window texture; the pictures clip highlights in HDR.
Folder for the shots pictures; it is created when needed. Only moves the output.
Set to any value to save shots at full size instead of 480x270. Files get far larger and writing them takes longer; has no effect without shots.
1 adds the player's position and ground speed to the frame-rate line that TOTK_TRACE=perf prints every 120 presents. Only adds log text; has no effect without TOTK_TRACE=perf.
0 makes a guest thread that polls memory keep its virtual core. Polling threads can starve the thread whose item they wait for, so frames can stall.
Microseconds a polling wait lasts before it gives its virtual core to a waiting thread. A shorter value hands cores over sooner; a longer one keeps them longer.

label.zh-Hans: 提前提交 GPU 工作

desc.en: Submits GPU work in parts every N draws between passes so the GPU starts earlier; 0 turns it off.
desc.ru: Отправляет работу GPU частями через каждые N отрисовок между проходами, чтобы GPU начинал раньше; 0 — выключено.
desc.pt-BR: Envia o trabalho da GPU em partes a cada N desenhos entre passes, para a GPU começar mais cedo; 0 desliga.
desc.zh-Hans: 在渲染通道之间每隔 N 次绘制分批提交 GPU 工作，让 GPU 更早开始；0 为关闭。

settings.doc: Submit GPU work in parts every N draws between passes so the GPU starts earlier (0 to 1000; 0 = off), each part at least split_us microseconds long (0 to 20000).
Submit GPU work in parts every N draws between passes so the GPU starts earlier (0 to 1000; 0 = off), each part at least split_us microseconds long (0 to 20000).
Gamepad stick dead zone in percent of full deflection (0 to 50). Raise it for a stick that drifts: inside the circle the stick reads centred, and the rest of its travel is scaled to start there.

desc.en: Multiplies the game's own right-stick camera speed, top speed included, at each of the game's five camera sensitivities. The mouse keeps its own setting.
desc.ru: Умножает скорость поворота камеры правым стиком, включая наибольшую, при каждой из пяти чувствительностей камеры в игре. На мышь не влияет.
desc.pt-BR: Multiplica a velocidade da câmera do analógico direito do jogo, incluindo a máxima, em cada uma das cinco sensibilidades de câmera do jogo. O mouse mantém a própria configuração.
desc.zh-Hans: 在游戏的五档镜头灵敏度下，按倍数调整右摇杆的镜头转动速度（包括最高速度）。鼠标使用自己的设置。

settings.doc: Right-stick camera speed (0.1 to 3): multiplies the game's own camera turn rates, top speed included, at each of the five camera sensitivities in the game's Options. Keys bound to the right stick follow it; the mouse keeps mouse_sens. Read at start.
<text>, <cancel> or <initial>: answers the on-screen keyboard (for example a horse name) without opening a window. The game gets that answer every time it asks for text.

One frame ahead of the GPU. Let the game build the next frame while the GPU still draws the previous one, 0 or 1. Default: off. Each frame the game waits once for the GPU to finish the frame it presented last; with 1 that wait covers the frame before it instead. On Great Sky Island (Linux, RX 9070 XT) with shadow_defer = 1 this took about 73 to 100 fps. Costs one more frame of input delay, and frame times vary more from frame to frame than with 0. GPU results the game reads back after that wait, for example occlusion queries, can be a frame old. Works on 1.1.0, 1.2.1 and 1.4.3. Needs shadow storage (shadow below), which is on by default on Linux and Wine and needs shadow = 1 on native Windows; without it the setting is ignored and the log says so.
ok or cancel opens the keyboard window and presses OK or Cancel on the first timer tick. The keyboard window closes by itself.

<site>:<n>[,...] fails the first n allocations at a site: commit (guest memory), staging (upload buffers), image (texture images), chunk (draw data buffers). Each forced failure takes the out-of-memory path: a memory release, a wait of 10 ms per retry and log lines; a large n stalls up to 30 s and then ends the game.

<lx>,<ly>,<rx>,<ry> attaches a virtual gamepad whose sticks rest at these raw SDL axis values (-32768 to 32767). The game sees a controller with that drift or deflection; a malformed value is logged and ignored.
1 translates every recorded shader on all usable CPUs during start. Start takes longer and fills the shader cache folder; the CPU is fully used while it runs.

desc.en: A new texture created over a live texture's memory starts with that content instead of empty.
desc.ru: Новая текстура поверх памяти живой текстуры получает её содержимое, а не пустую.
desc.pt-BR: Uma textura nova criada sobre a memória de uma textura viva começa com esse conteúdo em vez de vazia.
desc.zh-Hans: 在仍在使用的纹理内存上新建纹理时，新纹理沿用原有内容，而不是从空白开始。

settings.doc: A new texture created over a live texture's memory starts with that content instead of empty.

Block size in MiB of the pool that holds the game's textures; images of a quarter block or more get memory of their own. 0 puts textures in the default pools with the buffers. Larger blocks hold more memory that no texture uses; smaller ones mean more allocations from the driver.

Extra room in MiB (0 to 4096) for the heap the world's textures stream into, for HD texture packs. Packs made for emulators with 8 GB of DRAM grow it in their own HeapDef table (System/HeapSize/Product.Nin_NX_NVN.HeapDef.byml.zs): the port reads that growth at start and applies it itself (about 3339 MiB for the HDPacks 4K pack), so such a pack needs nothing here. Set it for a pack that ships textures without a HeapDef. Without the room the game keeps starting its panic Blood Moon. The memory pool grows by the same amount; the larger of this and a mod's growth counts. Read at start. Default: 0. Such a pack also needs much more video memory: astc_bc = 1 ([performance]) keeps its textures at a quarter of it.

desc.en: Optimisation: remembers texture descriptors between draws.
desc.ru: Оптимизация: запоминает дескрипторы текстур между отрисовками.
desc.pt-BR: Otimização: lembra os descritores de textura entre desenhos.
desc.zh-Hans: 优化：在多次绘制之间记住纹理描述符。

settings.doc: Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk, skip push constants that did not change, bind only the vertex buffers a draw reads, compare and copy each draw's state inline, and rebuild only the parts of a draw's bindings, shaders and pipeline whose inputs changed since the draw before (check: build everything and log any difference from what would have been kept).

MiB of textures the game released that are kept for reuse; older ones beyond it are dropped. 0 keeps up to 2048 of them, whatever their size. A larger value keeps more device memory and process commit; a smaller one makes the game create more textures again.

desc.en: Percent of video memory above which textures the game released are dropped (they come back from storage when used again). 0 keeps them.
desc.ru: Процент видеопамяти, выше которого освобождённые игрой текстуры удаляются (при повторном использовании загружаются снова). 0 — не удалять.
desc.pt-BR: Porcentagem da memória de vídeo acima da qual as texturas liberadas pelo jogo são descartadas (voltam do armazenamento quando usadas de novo). 0 mantém todas.
desc.zh-Hans: 显存占用超过这个百分比后，游戏已释放的纹理会被丢弃，再次用到时从存储重新加载。0 表示不丢弃。

settings.doc: Percent of the device-local memory budget above which released textures are dropped, 0 to 100; 0 is off. First those the game has overwritten with a later texture and left alone for 30 s, then those that can be uploaded again. A low value drops textures sooner and re-uploads them; 0 keeps them and lets the card spill into system memory. Also a slider in the menu.

desc.en: Raises the system timer resolution to 1 ms for steadier frame pacing.
desc.ru: Повышает точность системного таймера до 1 мс для ровного темпа кадров.
desc.pt-BR: Aumenta a resolução do timer do sistema para 1 ms, para um ritmo de quadros mais estável.
desc.zh-Hans: 将系统计时器精度提高到 1 ms，使帧间隔更平稳。

settings.doc: Windows timer resolution of 1 ms for steadier frame pacing (0 = the Windows default).

desc.en: Writes frame timings to a file.
desc.ru: Пишет время кадров в файл.
desc.pt-BR: Grava os tempos de quadro num arquivo.
desc.zh-Hans: 把每帧耗时写入文件。

settings.doc: Extra lines in the log, comma separated: svc, host, ipc, fs, gfx, perf, sched, audio, present or all. The menu's Performance log sets perf (frame timings). Default: none.
0 turns off the swap of gradient components for gradient texture samples. Terrain textures turned across the screen show crawling patches again.
0 binds live memory for uniform blocks; ab alternates with the ab blocks. Without snapshots late draws read another object's matrix, so objects can be drawn in the wrong place.

0 copies each uniform update inside a pass into its buffer at once, ending the pass with a full barrier; ab alternates with the ab blocks. With 0 scenes with many updated blocks (the terrain, the sky islands) take longer on the GPU; TOTK_TRACE=perf prints how many updates stayed in their pass.

0 copies each uniform update between passes into its buffer at once, behind a full barrier of its own; ab alternates with the ab blocks. Needs ub_overlay. With 0 a run of updates before a pass costs a full GPU barrier each; TOTK_TRACE=perf prints how many updates between passes were overlaid.

desc.en: How the picture is scaled when the window is larger than the game resolution. FSR keeps edges and detail sharper than bilinear.
desc.ru: Как картинка растягивается, когда окно больше разрешения игры. FSR сохраняет края и детали чётче билинейного.
desc.pt-BR: Como a imagem é ampliada quando a janela é maior que a resolução do jogo. O FSR mantém bordas e detalhes mais nítidos que o bilinear.
desc.zh-Hans: 窗口大于游戏分辨率时画面的放大方式。FSR 比双线性更能保留边缘和细节。

settings.doc: Scaling to the window when it is larger than the game resolution: fsr (AMD FSR 1) or bilinear, and FSR's sharpening from 0 (off) to 100. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.

Optimisations, 0 turns each off: skip bindings that did not change, remember shader lookups, reuse the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats, remember texture descriptors between draws, update descriptors in bulk, skip push constants that did not change, bind only the vertex buffers a draw reads, compare and copy each draw's state inline, and rebuild only the parts of a draw's bindings, shaders and pipeline whose inputs changed since the draw before (check: build everything and log any difference from what would have been kept).

desc.en: Forces dynamic alpha to coverage on or off. Default: off on AMD's driver for RDNA 2 and older, which draws characters black with it, and on Intel's Windows driver for integrated GPUs, which draws coloured noise on foliage; on elsewhere.
desc.ru: Принудительно включает или выключает динамический alpha to coverage. По умолчанию выключен на драйвере AMD для RDNA 2 и старше, где с ним персонажи чёрные, и на драйвере Intel для Windows на встроенных GPU, где с ним цветной шум на листве; включён на остальных.
desc.pt-BR: Força o alpha to coverage dinâmico ligado ou desligado. Padrão: desligado no driver da AMD para RDNA 2 e anteriores, que com ele desenha os personagens pretos, e no driver da Intel para Windows em GPUs integradas, que desenha ruído colorido na folhagem; ligado nos demais.

settings.doc: Dynamic alpha to coverage, 0 or 1. Default: on, except on AMD's driver for RDNA 2 and older (RX 400 to RX 6000), which applies alpha to coverage while the dynamic state says off and draws the characters black, and on Intel's Windows driver for integrated GPUs (UHD, Iris Xe), which draws coloured noise on foliage with it.

1 clears the 64-bit float feature, so the translator lowers FP64 to FP32. Shaders change, so the shader cache entries for it are made again; precision of FP64 shaders drops.

A thread of its own makes the Vulkan calls of each frame, 0 or 1. Default: on. Set 0 if an AMD GPU shows a black screen or stops with VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST.
Subgroup size to pin where the driver allows it. A value other than 32 changes what the translator is told about the GPU, and shaders are translated again.

Block size in MiB that the Vulkan memory allocator takes from the driver for buffers and other images on heaps over 1 GiB; larger allocations than half a block get memory of their own. 0 uses the allocator's 256. Larger blocks hold more memory that nothing uses; smaller ones mean more allocations from the driver.

0 turns off the spare half-block of video memory that a background thread keeps per memory type. Texture allocations on the render thread can wait for a new block again.

Pretends the device-local memory budget is at most this many MiB, for the paths that react to the budget (tex_vram_pressure, mirror refusal); the driver knows nothing of it. Lets a large card drive those paths; a low value drops released textures and refuses mirrors that would have fit.
all declares all 32 vertex shader output locations; otherwise only the union of the paired fragment inputs. Larger vertex shaders and new pipelines; unwritten outputs read the same as before.

desc.en: Hold it to tilt the keyboard's sticks part of the way, so the keyboard walks instead of runs. The walk scale sets how far. A controller and the mouse are not affected.
desc.ru: Удерживайте: стики клавиатуры отклоняются частично, и персонаж идёт, а не бежит. Насколько — задаёт сила шага. Контроллер и мышь не затрагиваются.
desc.pt-BR: Segure para inclinar os analógicos do teclado só em parte, assim o teclado anda em vez de correr. A intensidade do andar define quanto. Controle e mouse não são afetados.
desc.zh-Hans: 按住时键盘模拟的摇杆只推到一部分，使键盘操作走路而不是奔跑。推动幅度由步行幅度决定。手柄和鼠标不受影响。

settings.doc: The keyboard's sticks are all or nothing, so the game only sees a full tilt from them; while this key is held the keyboard-driven stick values shrink and the keyboard can walk instead of run. Key names as in the bind_ lines below, none turns it off. 0.2 to 0.9, the default holds for anything else. Only the keyboard is scaled: the mouse camera and the gamepad are unchanged. The Controls tab sets both. The default stops just above half because a keyboard sample of 32767 times 0.5 is one short of the 16384 the game's stick-direction bits need, and below that the keyboard stick reads as a partial tilt only.

desc.en: The tilt the keyboard's sticks get while the walk key is held. Half is a walk, the full tilt a run.
desc.ru: Отклонение стиков клавиатуры при удержании клавиши шага. Половина — шаг, полное отклонение — бег.
desc.pt-BR: A inclinação dos analógicos do teclado enquanto a tecla de andar está segura. Metade é andar, a inclinação total é correr.
desc.zh-Hans: 按住步行键时键盘摇杆的推动幅度。一半为走路，推满为奔跑。

settings.doc: The keyboard's sticks are all or nothing, so the game only sees a full tilt from them; while this key is held the keyboard-driven stick values shrink and the keyboard can walk instead of run. Key names as in the bind_ lines below, none turns it off. 0.2 to 0.9, the default holds for anything else. Only the keyboard is scaled: the mouse camera and the gamepad are unchanged. The Controls tab sets both. The default stops just above half because a keyboard sample of 32767 times 0.5 is one short of the 16384 the game's stick-direction bits need, and below that the keyboard stick reads as a partial tilt only.

With sync_ahead on, 1 copies small GPU-drawn targets that the game reads back to CPU-readable memory at the end of the frame that drew them, so the write-back at a fence wait does not wait for the GPU; 0 waits as before; check reads both ways and compares. Without sync_ahead it does nothing. With 0 the game thread stalls about every ninth frame while the copy queues behind the frame on the GPU, which takes back part of the frame-ahead gain. check is slow and for testing.
0 decides write-back of GPU-written textures by page only. A target that shares a page with data the CPU writes can go unwritten, so a name label next to the reticle can blink.

Render targets up to this size (bytes, 0 to 1073741824) go back to their game memory whenever the game waits for a GPU fence. A larger target goes back too unless the GPU drew it in each of the last 16 frames. A game that reads a larger target drawn every frame without invalidating it sees stale bytes at the default. With trace = gfx the log names each dirty target that stays on the GPU ("fence write-back skipped-drawn-every-frame") and each one over 65536 bytes that went back ("over-default"). Raising it costs a copy per such target and wait.

0 copies GPU-written ranges back as plain copies instead of writing word by word the words that changed; with shadow = 1 it also leaves ranges the GPU has yet to write back out of the copy into the shadow. In mirror memory mode, and with shadow = 1, the GPU's copy can overwrite words the CPU wrote, which breaks effects such as falling rain and waterfall splashes.

desc.en: Size of the game window when not fullscreen.
desc.ru: Размер окна игры вне полноэкранного режима.
desc.pt-BR: Tamanho da janela do jogo fora da tela cheia.
desc.zh-Hans: 非全屏时游戏窗口的大小。

settings.doc: Window client area in screen pixels (640x360 to 7680x4320), and borderless fullscreen. Windows display scaling does not apply: at 150% scale, 1920x1080 covers the area 1280x720 covers at 100%. F11 switches fullscreen and saves it here. Changes while the game runs take effect at once.

Path of the shader translator program; the default is totk_xlate beside totk.exe, else under build/xlate. Shaders are translated by that program; if it is missing the log says so and graphics shaders cannot be translated.

Text or 64 hex digits that identify the translator build in shader cache keys; the default comes from an .id file beside the translator, else a hash of the program. A value that two different builds share lets the cache serve shaders translated by the other build.
1 keeps the translation job of a last-frame variant as <key>.job with its code. Writes extra files to the shader cache folder; meant for running the translator by hand.
Number of translator processes allowed during play. More processes translate new shaders sooner and use more CPU and memory; values below 1 count as 1.
Host zstd decoder in place of the game's (0 = the game's), and a check that decodes every call both ways and logs the differences (1 = on; slow).
